posts.title: Think twice before do please..

posts.html:
I have been "analyzing" the unban requests lately.
What I see is mostly "Please unban me, I am sorry, It wont happen again, please unban me Ill kiss your ass" and so on...seriously...WTF?
Here is what I have figured out is the best solution so far if you are NOT permabanned, or banned for less than a month:
Keep quiet about it. What you can expect if you are banned for a week or so and make an unban request, is a big, fat
DENIED. <--This is something you DONT want to be publicly shown to the community, just because of the reason everyone will know you got banned, your request to be unbanned got denied and most people will treat you as a minge the rest of your life.
SO basically, unless you are permabanned, or banned for a insanely excessive time, please dont whine on the forum, just be patient and wait, and people will probably not remember the case of you ever being banned.
Also, remember that making unban requests that doesent have enough reason to it, CAN lengthen your ban further. The same thing goes for admin abuse: was it really that severe that it needs a admin abuse report, or was it just a one-time-only thing that doesent matter a rat's ass?

wrote this because Im tired of people whining for unbans that can easily be waited out, and I don't want our admins to be reported often, thus making them want to stop being admins, thus making the situations more chaotic than they are...
